result.instructions: Tools for Halaxy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments does Dr Smith have tomorrow, and who are the patients?"; "Find free 30-minute appointment times next week at the main clinic."; "List unpaid invoices from the last month with the amount owing.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Halaxy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run halaxy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run halaxy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run halaxy_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. halaxy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: halaxy_list_patients
tools.title: List or search patients
tools.description: List or search patient records (demographics and contact details; HEALTH DATA). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Patient.

name.description: Search the family, given or preferred name (matches the start of the name).

phone.description: A phone number, local or E.164 (+61412345678).

birthdate.description: Date of birth (ISO date or date-time, optional prefix eq/ne/gt/lt/ge/le).

created.description: Created (ISO date or date-time, optional prefix eq/ne/gt/lt/ge/le).

general_practitioner.description: A Practitioner/PractitionerRole the patient has records with.

id.description: One id or several separated by commas, for example 1,2,3.

last_updated.description: Only records last updated at this time (ISO date or date-time, optional prefix eq/ne/gt/lt/ge/le).

include.description: Also return related resources in "included": any of Patient:general-practitioner.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: halaxy_find_available_appointments
tools.title: Find available appointment times
tools.description: Find free appointment times between start and end for a given duration, respecting each practitioner's online booking preferences (buffer time, lead time, advance booking limit). Narrow it with practitioner, practitioner_role or organization. GET /main/Appointment/$find.

start.description: Start of the search window, e.g. 2027-01-12T00:00:00.

end.description: End of the search window, e.g. 2027-01-12T23:59:59.

show.description: first-available = only the first available time.

emergency.description: true ignores lead time, to show all times for emergency appointments.

apply_buffer_time.description: true applies buffer time to show all available times.

tools.name: halaxy_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Creates a new patient record (always a new one: search with halaxy_list_patients first to avoid a duplicate). Pass managing_organization (the practice group id, e.g. PG-12345, from halaxy_list_organizations) if Halaxy asks for it. POST /main/Patient.

mobile.description: Mobile number as +{country code}{number}, no spaces.

gender.description: Gender as registered in government records.

managing_organization.description: The practice group id, e.g. PG-12345.

tools.name: halaxy_create_appointment
tools.title: Book an appointment
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Books an appointment for a patient with a practitioner at a clinic (the practitioner role). Halaxy also creates the invoice, clinical note and reminder. Use halaxy_find_available_appointments for free times. By default a double booking is refused (HTTP 409, nothing created). POST /main/Appointment/$book.

practitioner_role_id.description: The PractitionerRole id (practitioner at a clinic), e.g. PR-1234567.

start.description: Start with the time zone offset, e.g. 2027-06-15T15:00:00+10:00.

end.description: End with the time zone offset, e.g. 2027-06-15T16:00:00+10:00.

charge_item_definition_id.description: The fee id (halaxy_list_fees) booked for the appointment.

fail_on_double_booking.description: Refuse if the practitioner already has an appointment then (default true).

tools.name: halaxy_update_appointment_status
tools.title: Update an appointment status
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Sets the patient's status on an appointment (shown in the Halaxy calendar), for example arrived, attended, confirmed or cancelled. "cancelled (no charge)" also sets the invoice to $0. For a group appointment pass patient_id to say whose status changes. PATCH /main/Appointment/{id}.

patient_id.description: The patient whose status changes (needed only when the appointment has several patients).

tools.name: halaxy_create_clinical_note
tools.title: Create a draft clinical note
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Adds a clinical note to a patient's record as a DRAFT (preliminary); the practitioner reviews and publishes it in Halaxy. The author is a PractitionerRole (practitioner at a clinic). Only HTML text is supported. POST /main/DocumentReference.

patient_id.description: The patient the note is for.

practitioner_role_id.description: The PractitionerRole id of the author, e.g. PR-1234567.
